# axm packs add

Add an extension to a pack manifest

## When to use

Add an extension to a pack manifest

## Usage

```bash
axm packs add [flags] <pack> <extension>
```

## Arguments

| Name        | Type   | Required | Description                    |
| ----------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------ |
| `pack`      | string | Yes      | Name of the pack               |
| `extension` | string | Yes      | Extension name or glob pattern |

## Flags

| Name            | Type    | Required | Description                                                 |
| --------------- | ------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--yes`, `-y`   | boolean | No       | Add without confirmation                                    |
| `--force`, `-f` | boolean | No       | Add even if the extension is already in the pack            |
| `--preview`     | boolean | No       | Show what would change in the manifest without modifying it |

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](../global-flags).

## Examples

**Bundle a skill into your pack**

```bash
axm packs add frontend-tools @acme/skills/code-review
```

**Add multiple extensions by pattern**

```bash
axm packs add my-pack "effect-*"
```

## Requirements

None.

## Side effects

None.
